about.statement: A shepherd's heart and a teacher's voice, devoted to proclaiming the Word with clarity and leading people into the presence of the Divine Majesty.
about.statementHighlight: the presence of the Divine Majesty.
about.bio: Theologian, international evangelist and expert in Christian leadership, he is the founder of JAFAN Ministries and of the Church of Christ for Nations in Bafoussam, Cameroon. Converted at 16 and called to ministry in 1996, he has given his life to equipping the Body of Christ, alongside his wife, Dr Dany Géraldine Kamedjieu.

articles.pageIntro: Every teaching and reflection by Prof. Kamedjieu on the Holy Spirit, leadership, the authority of Scripture and everyday life with God.

items.title: Walking in the fullness of the Holy Spirit
items.excerpt: What it means to be led by the Spirit day after day, and how His presence transforms the believer and the Church.

items.title: Servant leadership: leading the way Christ led
items.excerpt: Authority in the Kingdom is measured by service. Principles for pastors and leaders who want to lead like Jesus.

items.title: Why the authority of Scripture still matters today
items.excerpt: In an age of opinions, the Word of God remains the final reference for faith, doctrine and life.

items.title: From Bafoussam to the nations: lessons from the field
items.excerpt: Stories and lessons from thirty years of crusades and conferences carrying the Gospel across borders.

items.title: Faith, hope and love in everyday life
items.excerpt: Three virtues that never pass away, and simple ways to live them at home, at work and in the church.

items.title: Why every church needs well-trained leaders
items.excerpt: The vision behind the JAFAN Academy: equipping men and women to serve with knowledge and anointing.

reach.body: From his base in **Bafoussam, Cameroon**, Prof. Kamedjieu carries the Gospel across the nations through crusades and conferences, and trains Christian leaders through the **JAFAN Academy of World Evangelism** and its international university partnerships.
